label: Names
text: Mara Bell worked at Alderwick School. Tamsin Vale was the cook. Elian Reed tended the greenhouse. Ivo Pell kept the library.

label: Hearthlight compound
text: My mother called that sort of flame a hearthlight. They used to be common round here.

“Well, warmth wakes it. But it needs to borrow its colour.”

“From what?”

“Something particular to the place it belongs.”
